intro_en: We organize events, release albums, print zines, design games. And while we do these, we build a world.
intro_tr: Etkinlikler düzenliyoruz, albümler çıkarıyoruz, fanzinler basıyoruz, oyunlar tasarlıyoruz. Ve bunları yaparken bir dünya inşa ediyoruz.

notes.text: We're organizing EVENTS in **TURKEY**. We currently do events in **İZMİR** and **İSTANBUL**. We are interested in making events in other places as well.
notes.more:
if you have a space to offer for our events
we would like to hear about it.

notes.text: Uncivilization LABEL is on fair music platforms. Visit us on [mirlo](https://mirlo.space/uncivilization/), [fairplayer](https://fairplayer.band/player/artist/uncivilization@mirlo.space), [bandwagon](https://bandwagon.fm/@uncivilization), [acidnation](https://www.acidnation.com/label/uncivilization), [audius](https://audius.co/uncivilization), [artcore](https://www.artcore.com/uncivilization), [distrosub](https://www.distrosub.com/label/uncivilization), [itch.io](https://unciv.itch.io/), [bandcamp](https://uncivilization.bandcamp.com/album/no-boundaries-jungle-remixes) and [soundcloud](https://soundcloud.com/uncvl/sets/no-boundaries-jungle-remixes).
notes.more: if you are a music producer and you are into bass, breakcore, hardcore or punk, consider sending us your tunes.

call.body:
3 compilation is planned to be released.
Each compilation is designed to be a set of audio, artwork, illustration, visual, text, print, webpage and other material.

So...

This call is intended to a large group of people from different backgrounds.

A collection of songs from audio producers.
A collection of visual material from collabrating artists.
A collection of common knewledge and future speculation.

... songs, pictures, text ...

All of them will be exhibited in and distrubuted through physical places and internet.
